name: io.github.tukorama/mcp-server-worldquantbrain
description: Simulate alphas on WorldQuant BRAIN, inspect results, browse data fields and operators.

environmentVariables.name: WQB_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: BRAIN login email. Not needed after `mcp-server-worldquantbrain auth`.

environmentVariables.name: WQB_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: BRAIN password. Not needed after `mcp-server-worldquantbrain auth`.

environmentVariables.name: WQB_CREDENTIALS_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to a JSON file holding ["email", "password"].

environmentVariables.name: WQB_ALLOW_SUBMIT
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to expose the submit_alpha tool.
